missions.name: Vera C. Rubin Observatory (LSST)
missions.role: Argentinian In-Kind Program Manager · SCOC Footprint Task Force (DESC) · NOIRLab Ambassador (2023–2025)
missions.summary: Coordinating Argentina's In-Kind Contribution (>60 researchers across all 8 Rubin Science Collaborations), leading bright-star survey mask & footprint optimization, AI/ML photometric redshift work, and serving on ISSC, DESC, and TVS committees.
highlights: Data Rights member in DESC, TVS, and ISSC
SCOC Footprint Task Force DESC Representative (Aug–Oct 2026)
Co-organizer of LSST@LATAM 2024 (Chair) & Rubin Community Workshop SOC (2025–2026)

missions.name: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
missions.role: Rubin–Roman Joint Photometric Redshift & Survey Alignment Contributor
missions.summary: Advancing joint Rubin–Roman multi-band science through the Pontifex Mixture-of-Experts architecture (NeurIPS 2026), the NANCY Core Community Survey White Paper, and Rubin–Roman Galactic Plane Survey alignment.
highlights: NeurIPS 2026 Pontifex Rubin–Roman Photometric Redshift Challenge
NANCY Core Community Survey White Paper (arXiv:2306.11784)
Cross-survey footprint alignment via SCOC Footprint Task Force

missions.name: MEROPE (Horizon Europe MSCA)
missions.summary: International Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Staff Exchanges consortium (Project ID 101299854, EUR 1,007,010) led by INAF (Italy) focusing on stray-light modeling, astrometry, and survey masks for the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.
highlights: Total EU funding: EUR 1,007,010.00 (100%)
Stray-light characterization, astrometry & angular selection masks
Cross-continental staff exchange between Europe and Latin America

missions.name: LINCC Frameworks / LSST Discovery Alliance
missions.role: Co-PI (Incubator Cohort 4) & Visiting Scientist at CMU
missions.summary: Developing petabyte-scale open-source astronomical software frameworks (Skykatana, El Zorro, νGundam/Corrgi) natively integrated with HATS/LSDB hierarchical spatial partitioning.
highlights: LSST-DA LINCC Frameworks Incubator Cohort 4 (USD 22,500)
Collaboration between Carnegie Mellon University, IATE, and ICATE
Skykatana (A&C 2026) and νGundam (A&A 2026)

missions.name: Gaia DR3 & Local Volume Cosmology
missions.summary: Measuring dark matter subhalo masses for the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds via gravitational wakes imprinted in Milky Way halo stars using Gaia DR3 and Auriga cosmological simulations.
highlights: LMC subhalo mass determination (A&A 2024, 688, A147)
Improved gravitational wake formalism (MNRAS 2026, 545, staf2127)
SMC dark matter subhalo study submitted to MNRAS (2026)

missions.name: eROSITA & Low-Luminosity Galaxy Clusters
missions.summary: Statistical detection, weak gravitational lensing mass calibration, and physical characterization of low X-ray luminosity galaxy clusters across eROSITA and deep optical surveys.
highlights: eROSITA era low X-ray luminosity clusters (submitted to MNRAS, 2026)
Weak lensing mass calibration at 0.18 < z < 0.70 (MNRAS 2015)
Interacting galaxy cluster candidates (A&A 2018)

missions.name: MIA 21 cm Radio Interferometer
missions.summary: Simulating and modeling Epoch of Reionization 21 cm signals, primordial black hole seed effects, and velocity-drag signatures for Argentina's Multipurpose Interferometer Array (MIA).
highlights: Detection approximation for 21 cm EoR line with MIA (RMxAA SC 2024)
Prospects for Low-Frequency Radio Astronomy in South America (IAR)
EoR simulations with Primordial Black Hole seeds

missions.name: CosmoVerse · DeepSkies Lab · A4E
missions.summary: Contributing to global cosmology systematics & fundamental physics collaborations (CosmoVerse), deep-learning astrophysics communities (DeepSkies Lab), and sustainable astronomy advocacy (Astronomers for Planet Earth).
highlights: CosmoVerse White Paper on cosmological tensions (Physics of the Dark Universe 2025)
DeepSkies Lab AI/ML astrophysics network
Astronomers for Planet Earth member

missions.name: LIGO–Virgo & TOROS Collaboration
missions.role: Postdoctoral Fellow (CGWA) · NSF–CONICET PI · Core Member
missions.summary: Optical electromagnetic follow-up of gravitational-wave detections including GW150914 and the historic binary neutron star merger GW170817, plus architecting the Corral parallel pipeline framework.
highlights: Multi-messenger observations of GW170817 (ApJL 2017, L12 & L29)
GW150914 optical follow-up (ApJL 2016) & O2 campaign (MNRAS 2020)
Co-organizer of 1st TOROS Workshop (Salta, 2013) & Corral framework

missions.name: VISTA/VVV · SDSS · 2dFGRS · Gemini
missions.summary: Two decades of foundational extragalactic and Milky Way survey science across 2dFGRS, SDSS, and ESO's VISTA VVV near-infrared survey—including discovery of the first galaxy cluster in VVV—alongside Gemini Observatory time allocation service.
highlights: First Galaxy Cluster discovered by VISTA VVV (ApJ 2019, 874, 86)
Milky Way bulge & 136M-star VVV photometry (A&A 2013; MNRAS 2013)
Foundational 2dFGRS galaxy group & SDSS satellite studies (2001–2012)

Co-PI with ICATE on LINCC Frameworks Incubator (Skykatana, νGundam), Doctoral Monitoring Committees, and CART Line Intensity Mapping Workshop.
MIA 21 cm collaborations with IAR, AAA Executive Board & 64th AAA Meeting, Pabellón Cero+Infinito public & plenary lectures, and Astroinformatics NOVA.
Visiting Scientist (October 2002) and invited/contributed workshops on structure formation and galaxy groups.
Invited speaker at 'Fundamental Physics meets Current and Future Facilities in Cosmology' (Dec 2024) on LSST LSS & Local Volume Cosmology.
Scientific Organizing Committee (SOC) member and Invited Panelist on astronomical research in Latin America at LSST@LATAM 2025.

Horizon Europe MSCA MEROPE Consortium led by INAF (PI: Dr. G. Rodeghiero); Argentinian Node Coordinator at IATE–OAC–UNC.
Co-advising Master's Research Internship (Basma Chraibi, 2025) on Multimodal Foundation Models in Astrophysics.
Visiting Scientist at MPA Garching on large-scale structure, galaxy groups, and dark matter halos.
